data.title: Define and integrate the common office work and step model
data.description: Follow docs/office-operating-model.md phase 1. Publish concrete schema/API mapping before changes; extend the canonical Python runtime rather than replace current task/order/ticket states. Done: accountable owner, outcome, step dependencies, completion evidence and execution attempt mapping with existing API and purchase safeguards preserved.

data.title: Add durable routines, waiting, follow-up and escalation
data.description: Phase 2: persist recurrence identity/timezone/missed-run behavior, waiting reasons, next review, bounded reminders and escalation owner. Done: restart-safe scheduling, duplicate ticks/overlapping work handled and no unresolved work without a next review; external channels remain authorization-gated.

data.title: Complete replenishment and maintenance outcomes on the common workflow
data.description: Phase 3: reuse existing procurement/facility implementations, attach receipt/repair evidence and follow-up rather than reimplement their decision logic. Done: order confirmation is distinct from receipt, sensor recovery is distinct from repair acceptance, stale approval and uncertain execution safeguards retained.

data.title: Design people logistics and meeting follow-through templates
data.description: Phase 4: onboarding/offboarding, meeting commitments, calendar and inbox on shared work/steps. Done: owner/dependency/authority/completion contracts plus simulated adapter verification; no live messages, bookings or access changes without separate action authorization.

data.title: Design priorities, decision preparation and reporting templates
data.description: Phase 5: goals/milestones, source-backed research and updates, renewal decisions and board/investor preparation with explicit human decision owners. Done: traceable sources, commitments and accepted outcomes; no autonomous strategic/personnel/legal/financial authority.
